question: The average age of 19 students is 17 years. A teacher joins the group, and the average becomes 18 years. What is the teacher's age?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's Age = New Average + (Old Members × Increase in Average)

Old Members = 19 students

Increase in Average = 18 − 17 = 1 year

Teacher's Age = 18 + (19 × 1) = 37 years

**∴ The correct answer is 37 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 19 students = 17 years

New average age after teacher joins = 18 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of values = Average × Number of values

 

 323 years
 
 
 19 students (19 × 17)
 
 
 
 19 students
 Teacher
 
 

 20 members total = 20 × 18 = 360 years
 
 360 − 323 = 37
 
• 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 19 students = 19 × 17 = 323 years

⇒ Number of members after teacher joins = 19 + 1 = 20 members

⇒ Total age of 20 members = 20 × 18 = 360 years

⇒ Teacher's age = Total age of 20 members − Total age of 19 students

⇒ Teacher's age = 360 − 323 = 37 years

**∴ The correct answer is 37 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

When two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ with averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Exclusion of a Member

If a person leaves the group, Age of leaving person = Old Average − (New Total Members × Change in Average). Keep the positive or negative sign of the change intact.

Replacement of a Member

When a new person replaces an old one, Age of new person = Age of removed person + (Total Members × Increase in Average).
